Most people think of Halloween as harmless fun—costumes, candy, and spooky decorations. But what if it's actually Satan’s high holy day?
🎃 Halloween traces back to the Druidic festival of Samhain, a pagan ritual where priests lit bone-fires, sacrificed animals—and sometimes humans—and believed the veil between worlds was thinnest. Costumes weren’t for fun—they were disguises to blend in with evil spirits so you wouldn’t be targeted.
🩸 Today, October 31st remains a sacred date in satanic circles. Police departments have training manuals to recognize ritual sacrifice symbols, bloodletting, and child abduction patterns associated with Halloween.
This isn’t superstition—it’s spiritual warfare hidden in plain sight. Are you letting darkness through the front door… disguised as fun?
